title: Mitigating Barren Plateaus in Variational Quantum Circuits through PDE-Constrained Loss Functions
summary: The barren plateau phenomenon; where cost function gradients vanish exponentially with system size; remains a fundamental obstacle to training variational quantum circuits (VQCs) at scale. We demonstrate, both theoretically and numerically, that embedding partial differential equation (PDE) constraints into the VQC loss function provides a natural and effective mitigation mechanism against barren plateaus.
